name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen remodeling begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen remodeling begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before demolition starts, remove all cookware, dishware, and food items from cabinets and pantries. Setting up a temporary kitchen area in an adjoining dining room or basement with a microwave, coffee maker, and small refrigerator helps keep daily routines manageable. You should also finalize selections for appliances, countertops, fixtures, and tile before work begins to avoid shipping delays. We review these steps with homeowners prior to day one to protect adjacent living areas and establish a clear staging path for materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all cabinets, finalize your material and appliance orders, and set up a temporary cooking station in an adjacent room to maintain daily routines during work.
